tasks.title: Agree the UI planning baseline, full inventory, ownership/API gaps and migration design.
tasks.acceptance: Review 178 tracked paths/hashes, master-clause coverage, requirement/task links, dependency graph and preserved history. Planning agreement remains pending.

tasks.title: Establish a fresh downstream Qt baseline before moving source.
tasks.acceptance: Record exact candidate/toolchain, existing Qt Rust and QML results, native build/startup and current DS/project smoke. Prior backend evidence is historical context.

tasks.title: Enforce the public-API boundary before migration.
tasks.acceptance: Add Cargo identity/source guard and negative alias/direct-call cases, reviewed finite legacy-site list with sunset tasks; no new scientific exceptions.

tasks.title: Expose compatible input/editor/preview admission through the facade.
tasks.acceptance: Specify exact typed extensions, native-input re-exports and parity; preserve independent builds and editor/Designer/provenance behavior. Core/API plus installed-wheel tests precede Qt adoption.

tasks.title: Complete downstream controlled jobs and retained public observations.
tasks.acceptance: Typed full-loop request/control/result contracts reuse existing owners; validate pause/cancel/progress, immutable bounded observations, PSD/MER/FEC/PRBS and old outputs plus Python parity. Commit before matching Qt calls migrate.

tasks.title: Add bounded idle upstream resource-grid observation.
tasks.acceptance: Finalize grid request/snapshot fields/budgets, reuse ResourcePlan and literal coordinate vectors, all accepted patterns/numerologies, no hidden run/mutation and installed-wheel parity. Commit before viewer work.

tasks.title: Close only actual upstream instrument API gaps.
tasks.acceptance: Map every required window to existing/new typed observations; validate real stage/tap/response/soft/FEC data, bounds, reference planes, unsupported modes and Python parity before Qt exposure.

tasks.title: Define and implement direction-aware public project admission.
tasks.acceptance: Finalize schema 3 field/version/aggregate budget design; retain schema 1/2 DS semantics; validate original inputs, both direction load/run/serialize and Rust/Python/UI fixture parity before Qt consumer changes.

tasks.title: Move proven generic shell/theme/dialog infrastructure by inventory.
tasks.acceptance: Focused moves with notices, explicit registrations/imports/resources, all bridge entries together, same module/entry/executable; matching Qt checks and native build. Do not pre-accept scientific instruments as shared.

tasks.title: Organize downstream owners and migrate legacy scientific calls.
tasks.acceptance: Adopt validated facade operations, remove matching legacy guard entries, preserve existing presentation/readiness/instruments/results, tests and project semantics; build latest Qt executable.

tasks.title: Make direction sessions explicit and serialize initial dispatch.
tasks.acceptance: Remove implicit input/latest-result routing, identify session/generation/run callbacks, keep isolated stores and aggregate retention budgets; test Busy/paused ownership, stale callbacks, cancel/destruction and no cross-tab overwrite.

tasks.title: Build persistent direction tabs and scoped shell actions.
tasks.acceptance: Preserve File/Settings/About/update and DS workbench, remove internal canvas title, retain controls/focus; test switching during idle/run/pause, selections, separate dirty states and second Start rejection.

tasks.title: Implement approved upstream startup layout and configuration drill-ins.
tasks.acceptance: Requires user's upstream diagram/final visual agreement. Keep CM→channel→CMTS samples separate from controls, H/C/C×H/RxMER labels, typed Apply/Cancel and supported-mode admission; no inferred wider support.

tasks.title: Connect upstream execution and direction lifecycle.
tasks.acceptance: Only public API worker; actual bounded runs/progress/cancel/partial results, direction-owned controls and results, responsive Qt and downstream isolation. No internal engine access.

tasks.title: Integrate upstream native PNM inputs and viewers.

tasks.title: Render authoritative upstream allocation/pilot grid.

tasks.title: Share compatible FEC/verification presentation.

tasks.title: Wire per-direction project Save/Open and dirty guards.
tasks.acceptance: Legacy DS plus new DS/US round trips and Rust/Python load/run, direction routing and target-tab dirty guard, cancel/failure preservation, safe writes and both-tab close behavior.

tasks.title: Preserve both direction projects across application restart/update.
tasks.acceptance: Bounded private recovery bundle of independently API-valid projects and active-tab/UI state, atomic restore/failure tests and source-install guards; no installed lifecycle claim without native evidence.

tasks.title: Accept unified Qt functionality and reconcile final correspondence.
